genres.name: Synthwave
genres.details: Wikipedia calls it an electronic music microgenre. Rate Your Music traces its roots to the French electro house and electro scenes of the mid-2000s (Kavinsky, College, Anoraak, Minitel Rose) and credits the Drive and Hotline Miami soundtracks; 11,353 releases (2026-10-25). Related: Vaporwave, Eurobeat, Synth-pop, New wave (Wikipedia, other topics). Musicmap pairs it with Vaporwave as Synthwave & Vaporwave (dtp14, 2012, Downtempo / Ambient family); here it is its own family.

genres.name: Vaporwave
genres.description: Sample-based music built from heavily processed corporate mood and elevator music, slowed down, chopped and looped with plenty of reverb. It grew from the Eccojams of Chuck Person and spread around 2012 with James Ferraro's Far Side Virtual and Macintosh Plus's Floral Shoppe.
genres.details: An internet microgenre, aesthetic and meme from the early 2010s, defined by slowed, chopped samples of smooth jazz, elevator music, R&B and lounge from the 1980s-90s, with a satirical take on consumer culture. 14,896 releases on Rate Your Music (2026-10-25). RYM parent: Vapor; Wikipedia treats it as a separate genre from Synthwave and lists it as related; Musicmap pairs them as Synthwave & Vaporwave (dtp14, Downtempo / Ambient family, 2012). Related: Synthwave. In v1 it stays a child of synthwave.

genres.name: Chillsynth
genres.description: A slow, dreamy, lo-fi take on synthwave that borrows from chillwave and hypnagogic pop. HOME's Resonance (Odyssey, 2014) is the usual starting point.
genres.details: 714 releases on Rate Your Music (2026-10-25). Rate Your Music lists two parents, Synthwave and Chillwave; only Synthwave is used here. Chillwave and Indietronica form Musicmap's Indietronica & Chillwave node (con05, 2005, Contemporary Rock, hybrid with Pop) and belong to a later indie cluster.

genres.name: Darksynth
genres.description: A heavier, darker and faster synthwave from the early 2010s, with horror-film synths and aggressive basslines. Perturbator, Carpenter Brut, Mega Drive and Scattle are typical, and the Blood Music label is a hub.

genres.name: Dreamwave
genres.description:
Tempo: about 80-100 BPM.
A gentle, ethereal synthwave with breathy, reverbed vocals, also nicknamed Pop Synthwave or Popwave. College and Electric Youth, The Midnight and FM-84 are typical.

genres.name: Outrun
genres.details: The early, dance-oriented main style of synthwave: fast, energetic beats, driving basslines, arpeggios and a nocturnal mood, named after the OutRun games. Kavinsky, Futurecop!, Mitch Murder, Lazerhawk and Miami Nights 1984 are typical. 224 releases on Rate Your Music (2026-10-25). Rate Your Music lists a second parent, Electronic Dance Music, which is not a Genres map v2 genre; only Synthwave is used here.

genres.name: Sovietwave
genres.description: A scene of synthwave in the former USSR countries since the early 2010s, drawing on Soviet electronic music and film scores and on the Polivoks synthesizer. Artemyev and Zatsepin are cited as influences.
genres.details: A scene of synthwave: Rate Your Music files it under Scenes & Movements, not as a style, while Wikipedia calls it a subgenre of synthwave. 106 releases on Rate Your Music (2026-10-25).
